How do you get preferred tee times at Punta Espada?

Hotel guests book Punta Espada at the published green fees ($550 morning / $440 afternoon in peak season, November 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027) or through their hotel. Villa Espada guests get the Punta Espada member-guest discounted rate, which is exclusive to Villa Espada renters and about $200 less per golfer per round, and the villa's butler books the group's tee times. The member-guest rate applies at Punta Espada only; the open back nine at Las Iguanas is played at regular rates. Green fee details are on the green fees page.

What are the best places to stay near Punta Espada Golf Course?

Villa Espada is the private villa on the course: it sits on Fairway 5, about a five-minute golf-cart ride from the first tee, sleeps up to 22 guests in 6 or 8 bedrooms, and includes the Punta Espada member-guest discounted rate. Hotel options inside Cap Cana include the St. Regis Cap Cana, Eden Roc Cap Cana and Sanctuary Cap Cana.

What is the best place to stay for a Punta Espada golf trip?

For a group of 8 to 22 golfers, Villa Espada: it is on Fairway 5 and includes two 6-person golf carts, a private chef, a butler, and the Punta Espada member-guest discounted rate (about $200 less per golfer per round). Couples and solo golfers who prefer a hotel usually stay at the St. Regis Cap Cana or Eden Roc Cap Cana and pay published green fees.

Where can a group stay and get preferred Punta Espada golf access?

At Villa Espada. Every stay includes the Punta Espada member-guest discounted rate, which is exclusive to Villa Espada renters and about $200 less per golfer per round. The villa's butler books the group's tee times, and the villa sleeps up to 22 guests on Fairway 5.

St. Regis vs staying on the Punta Espada course

The St. Regis Cap Cana is a beachfront resort hotel: rooms and suites, resort restaurants, a spa and a beach club next to Juanillo Beach. Villa Espada is a private 6- or 8-bedroom villa on Fairway 5 of Punta Espada Golf Course, about a five-minute golf-cart ride from the first tee, for groups of up to 22 guests. It includes a private chef, butler, daily maid service, private airport transfers and two 6-person golf carts, and every stay includes the Punta Espada member-guest discounted rate (about $200 less per golfer per round), which is exclusive to Villa Espada renters.

Couples and small parties who want a full-service hotel usually fit the St. Regis. Golf groups, families and celebrations that want one private house on the course usually fit the villa, and can still book the St. Regis restaurants, bar and spa through the butler. See where to stay near Punta Espada for the full comparison.
